title: Difference Character of Two Covering Splittings
body_html:
Difference Character of Two Covering Splittings

Let \(\xi\) and \(\xi_1\) be two splittings of the same covering group over \(K\). Their ratio is the character \[ \mu_{\xi_1,\xi}:K\to\mathbb C^\times \] defined by \[ \mu_{\xi_1,\xi}(k)\xi_1(k)=\xi(k). \]

This character is the correction term in the equivalence relation for covering data. If the two splittings agree on \(K_{0+}\), then \(\mu_{\xi_1,\xi}\) is trivial on \(K_{0+}\) and descends to the finite reductive quotient.
